# BackTheVibes

> BackTheVibes is a platform connecting independent musicians, listeners, and DJs directly. Fans discover and financially support independent artists through direct monthly memberships. DJs discover tracks and license them directly from the artist who made them, with a real e-signed agreement covering permitted use, territory, duration, and price. Artists publish music, keep control of licensing terms, and earn directly from both fan support and DJ licensing — without a label or algorithmic royalty pool in between.

## Key facts

- Listening, following artists, and building a library is free for fans.
- An optional Supporter membership (from £4.99/month) lets a fan direct monthly support to the independent artists they follow. Artists receive 80% of net supporter revenue directed to them, after payment processing and tax.
- Joining as a DJ is free. DJs pay only for the licences they agree to, on terms the artist sets per track.
- Artists publish for a flat £29.99/year — not a percentage of earnings. Artists keep 85% of net DJ licensing revenue.
- Every DJ licence is a dated, e-signed agreement between the artist and the DJ, specifying permitted use, territory, duration, and price. The full-quality track only unlocks once the agreement is signed.
- Payments are processed by Stripe. BackTheVibes does not store full card details.
